patronOf.en-US: Bishop and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we rightly understand and truthfully profess the divinity of your Son.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Conhecer e proclamar fielmente a divindade do vosso Filho.

meta.face: A robust man of about fifty-five with a broad, trapezoid face, wider at the temples than at the jaw — a high, broad forehead with white hair receding from it, a strong, straight nose with a broad bridge, wide-set, clear grey eyes under heavy, arched white brows, ruddy, full cheekbones, a firm mouth half-hidden by a white moustache; a long, broad, flowing white beard spread over the chest in soft waves; an earnest, penetrating gaze straight ahead.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; Christian Iconography notes that portraits usually give him episcopal vestments, mitre and crozier, and a beard usually white and often long, and the card keeps the tradition, with a broad, vigorous face for the fighter against Arianism. The baptistery of Saint-Jean at Poitiers dates from his century.
